name: Prediction Error Computation
description: Hierarchical prediction error in cortical circuits: comparison of top-down predictions with bottom-up sensory signals. Core mechanism of predictive processing (Rao & Ballard, 1999). Generates error signals that drive perceptual inference and learning.
key_references: Rao, R. P., & Ballard, D. H. (1999). Predictive coding in the visual cortex: A functional interpretation of some extraclassical receptive-field effects. Nature Neuroscience, 2(1), 79-87.
Bastos, A. M., Usrey, W. M., Adams, R. A., Mangun, G. R., Fries, P., & Friston, K. J. (2012). Canonical microcircuits for predictive coding. Neuron, 76(4), 695-711.
empirical_evidence: Computational models explain V1 receptive fields and surround suppression. fMRI studies show prediction error signals in visual cortex. Lesion and inactivation studies implicate top-down connections in error generation. Less direct evidence than CANONICAL atoms but strong theoretical grounding.
